Subject: Need help with a divorce by mutual consent case

Hello, my name is Mohan Menon. I am a 52-year-old nurse living in Madurai. My spouse Anjali Fernandes and I want a divorce by mutual consent with a settlement of ₹8,20,000, and the wife wants her jewellery and gifts returned. My case number is Petition No. 2736/2019 in the Family Court at Madurai. Can your firm advise me on what to do next? You can call me on +91 72412 54764 or email mohan.menon@example.in.
